description:
A data import error caused a duplicate customer record for 'Hyperion Systems'. You need to clean this up.

There are two records:
1. 'Hyperion Systems Inc.' (Keep this one - it has the physical address)
2. 'Hyperion Systems' (Duplicate - it has the email address)

Your task:
1. Copy the email address from 'Hyperion Systems' to 'Hyperion Systems Inc.'
2. Reassign any opportunities currently linked to 'Hyperion Systems' so they belong to 'Hyperion Systems Inc.' instead.
3. Archive the 'Hyperion Systems' record (do not delete it).
